da-non-sequitur.notes: The argument flow in 'Proof of Integration of skewed-Poisson structures' is logically sound, mapping onto the cited dependencies.

da-non-sequitur.evidence: Lean: `ctx.claim_i/ii/iii` projected from a context class (self-assuming). Statement item 2 asks the Hopf comultiplication of Dist(G) to satisfy the *Frobenius* relation (Id⊗m)(Δ⊗Id) = Δ∘m. That fails for any Hopf algebra with a nonzero primitive x: put a = 1, b = x; LHS = 1⊗x, RHS = Δx = x⊗1 + 1⊗x. "Strong multiplicativity" (Δ an algebra map) is a different identity. Proof: one-paragraph citation of "the Main Theorem of Fresse" with no bibliographic key, and it numbers three items (1)(2)(3) against a statement with two; item (3)'s "p-adic filtration" text uses an undefined macro `\pp`
